cart/info/basic.description: Full store/connection info shape (response_fields={*}): store name, stores_info with the seller id and currency, 9 warehouses with addresses, and Walmart feed/throttle configuration under additional_fields. Note what is NOT here -- no carriers list (order.shipment.add's carrier_id vocabulary is fixed in the integration, not returned by this method) and shipping_zones is empty

category/count/basic.description: Total category count for the store (no filters).

category/info/basic.description: Full single-category info shape (response_fields={*}) for a real category id harvested from category.list basic.

category/info/error-not-found.description: not found: no category with this id

category/list/basic.description: Full category entity shape (response_fields={*}), including the large category_properties schema block that marketplace_item_properties must be built from. Careful: categories_count here is the size of THIS page (3), while category.count returns the store total (80)

category/list/error-invalid-param.description: validation: count must be a non-negative integer

category/list/page-2.description: Second page of categories reached via cursor-based pagination (page_cursor from the basic call's pagination.next, URL-decoded once).

order/count/basic.description: Total order count for the store (no filters).

order/count/order-status-shipped.description: Filter: order_status=Shipped, count of orders in the Shipped state.

order/info/basic.description: Full single-order info shape (response_fields={*}) for a real order_id harvested from order.list basic.

order/info/error-not-found.description: not found: no order with this order_id

order/list/basic.description: Full order entity shape (response_fields={*}) for 3 real orders, showing Cancelled and Created statuses.

order/list/error-invalid-param.description: validation: count must be a non-negative integer

order/list/order-status-shipped.description: Filter: order_status=Shipped, returning only orders in the Shipped state.

order/shipment.add/all-open-lines.description: omit items[] to ship every line of the order that is still unshipped, instead of listing them one by one

order/shipment.add/basic.description: happy path: ship one order line. order_product_id is the order LINE NUMBER as returned by order.info/order.list, not a long id, and carrier_id must be one of the integration's fixed carrier keys

order/shipment.add/error-all-items-alrea.description: conflict: every line of this order is already shipped, so there is nothing left to ship

order/shipment.add/error-empty-tracking-.description: validation: a known carrier with an empty tracking number is still rejected

order/shipment.add/error-multiple-tracki.description: validation: exactly one tracking number per call -- shipping lines with different carriers takes one call each

order/shipment.add/error-no-tracking-num.description: validation: tracking_numbers is mandatory on Walmart even though openapi does not mark it required -- a shipment cannot be created without one

order/shipment.add/error-order-item-not-.description: not found: the line number does not exist on this order

order/shipment.add/error-quantity-exceed.description: conflict: shipping more units than the line actually has

order/shipment.add/error-unknown-carrier.description: validation: carrier_id must be one of the integration's fixed keys, and the error lists every accepted value -- cart.info does not expose them on Walmart

order/shipment.list/basic.description: Full shipment entity shape (response_fields={*}) for a real shipped order, including tracking numbers and shipped items.

order/shipment.list/error-invalid-param.description: validation: count must be a non-negative integer

order/status.list/basic.description: Full list of the 5 native Walmart order statuses (Created, Acknowledged, Shipped, Cancelled, Delivered).

product/add/basic.description: happy path: create an item. Beyond the three fields openapi marks required, Walmart also needs sku, category_id, image_url and exactly one product identifier (upc/ean/gtin/isbn) -- the integration dereferences all of them unconditionally

product/add/error-empty-name.description: validation: a required parameter present but empty is rejected differently from a missing one -- 109, not 114

product/add/error-identifier-already-lis.description: conflict: a new sku is not enough -- the same UPC/EAN/GTIN/ISBN may only be listed once per seller, and the error names the sku that already holds it

product/add/error-no-params.description: validation: name, description and price are the openapi-required trio; the first missing one is named

product/add/error-sku-already-exists.description: conflict: the sku is the product id on Walmart, so re-using one that already exists in the store is rejected before the feed is submitted

product/add/scheduled-with-avail-from.description: scheduled listing: avail_from sets Walmart's startDate, so the item goes live at a future moment instead of immediately (omitting it makes the integration send "now")

product/add/with-marketplace-item-proper.description: category-specific attributes: marketplace_item_properties is a JSON-encoded string whose keys must come from that category's own schema, which category.info returns in additional_fields.category_properties (keys below are from category 559c5d924fff3d64de18bf45)

product/count/basic.description: Total product count for the store (no filters).

product/delete/by-id.description: happy path: retire an item by its sku (Walmart retires rather than erases -- the item stays retrievable with lifecycleStatus RETIRED)

product/delete/error-already-retired.description: conflict: deleting an item that is already retired is refused rather than treated as a no-op

product/delete/error-not-found.description: not found: no item with this sku

product/find/error-not-found.description: not found: searching for a brand that product.list shows on six items still returns not_found -- like product.info, product.find could not be made to succeed on this store; note the wording here is "Entity not found", not product.info's "Item not found"

product/info/error-not-found.description: not found: this id comes straight from product.list (a published, saleable item) and still resolves to not_found -- product.info could not be made to succeed for any id on this store, so this is the only observed behaviour of the method here, not a made-up id

product/list/avail-view-true.description: Filter: avail_view=true narrows the same catalogue to the 4 items that are actually published and buyable; products_count stays at the unfiltered store total of 20

product/list/basic.description: Full product entity shape (response_fields={*}): the whole 20-item catalogue comes back in one page, and products_count is the STORE total, not the page size

product/list/error-invalid-param.description: validation: count must be a non-negative integer

product/update/error-not-found.description: not found: no item with this sku

product/update/update-price.description: update the price of an existing item (id is the seller sku, taken from product.list)

product/update/update-price-and-quantity.description: price and quantity in one call -- they are two separate Walmart endpoints internally, and the response reports the combined outcome

product/update/update-quantity.description: update seller-owned inventory; WFS (Walmart-fulfilled) inventory cannot be changed through this method
